translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from source extraction and all twenty PDF page images. No prior English translation or translation service used. Edition glossary and primary dictionaries consulted; interpretation and uncertainties recorded per source ID. No independent specialist review.

notes.manas-2010:p0612:b001:l001: The opening conditional continues Manas’s deliberation from page611; “this soul” refers to himself.
notes.manas-2010:p0612:b001:l002: Кызырдуу is read as endowed with Khizir’s blessing; the diplomatic speech remains a provisional contextual interpretation.
notes.manas-2010:p0612:b001:l012: The unsheathed sword is an epic readiness formula, retained literally.
notes.manas-2010:p0612:b001:l013: Заар is poison/fierceness; “wrath” follows the martial epithet.
notes.manas-2010:p0612:b001:l016: Даңгыл characterizes experienced breadth of judgment, rendered far-seeing.
notes.manas-2010:p0612:b001:l026: Тил албай: provisionally not receiving an answer; could emphasize failure to communicate rather than a previously spoken question.
notes.manas-2010:p0612:b001:l028: Олуя-Ата retained as the named locality, not translated as holy father.
notes.manas-2010:p0612:b001:l033: Yudakhin жардан- means stare curiously/in astonishment; it does not mean bristle here. https://el-sozduk.kg/жарда/
notes.manas-2010:p0612:b001:l035: Same-edition glossary1842:b001:l033 explicitly defines Сүт кымыран as элейип, делдейип: staring dumbfounded. Not a milk-drinking event.
notes.manas-2010:p0612:b001:l039: Blood-with-blood wording kept literally; its exact rhetorical construction is awkward.
notes.manas-2010:p0612:b001:l042: The divine decree sentence continues613:l001; no row omitted.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l002: Түп этек: lower hem/bottom edge, retained as a grappling image.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l010: Same-edition glossary1842:b001:l033: Сүт кымыран = элейип, делдейип, staring dumbfounded. Repeated formula fully retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l017: Same-edition glossary1844:b001:l006 identifies Ырапыс as cloth, Russian репс (rep). Rendered ribbed cloth without inventing fiber composition.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l018: Бука сийдик literally bull’s urine; the trail winds like its track. The conventional path image is rendered winding rather than a literal liquid road.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l020: Зың-зың is sound/manner imagery; steady motion is a provisional contextual rendering.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l022: Бучкак is the lower trouser/garment extremity; disdainful comparison retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l024: Алтын жаак literally golden cheeks/sides of the axe head; not necessarily a golden cutting edge.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l025: Ач билек read as bare forearm, where the battle-axe is suspended.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l026: Кандагай is deerskin clothing/trousers; the garment is explicitly called шым at28.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l029: Милтелеп: wick-like narrow strands/braiding; gold trimming rather than firearm wicks.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l030: Кундуз rendered otter in the traditional fur context; species identification remains broad.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l031: Yudakhin багалакI redirects to багалек (trouser leg); this differs from багалакII knucklebone striker at624:l027. https://el-sozduk.kg/багалак/
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l033: Golden-cheeked battle-axe repeats24; not omitted as duplication.
notes.manas-2010:p0613:b001:l042: Көйкашка is an outstanding/prominent individual, not a personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p0614:b001:l003: Сыр найза is painted/lacquered spear, not a secret spear.
notes.manas-2010:p0614:b001:l008: Илекер read as resourceful/ingenious, alongside wisdom.
notes.manas-2010:p0614:b001:l017: Кожо rendered holy men; religious status is broader than modern clerical office.
notes.manas-2010:p0614:b001:l018: Кожолору колдо өсүп literally holy men growing under his hand; care/patronage reading provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0614:b001:l019: Эшен: spiritual/Sufi master; the line attributes this quality to Bakay.
notes.manas-2010:p0614:b001:l037: Бай is read as the father’s name Bay, explicitly identified at623:l016, while also carrying the ordinary rich-man sense.
notes.manas-2010:p0614:b001:l038: Visible озун, understood as оозун mouth from the honey-rinsing formula and exact repetition621:l017. Raw is unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0615:b001:l014: Чоро is a warrior companion/retainer, translated companion here.
notes.manas-2010:p0615:b001:l018: The youngest of six lions modifies Manas in19, not Bakay; original line order retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0615:b001:l030: Akkula identifies Manas as the mounted observer; rapid changes of subject remain in the source.
notes.manas-2010:p0615:b001:l035: Narratorial appeal to God interrupts description; exact syntax remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0615:b001:l036: Six months of hardship is the child’s foreknowledge horizon, connected to39–41.
notes.manas-2010:p0615:b001:l040: The speaking child occupies Bakay’s right shoulder; supernatural motif translated literally.
notes.manas-2010:p0616:b001:l004: Ат бороюн is атборой, the whole earth, not horse exhaustion. Same-edition glossary1834:b001:l022; 2015dictionary exact epic сыдыртып construction at https://el-sozduk.kg/атборой/
notes.manas-2010:p0616:b001:l010: Zhelpinish is the epic far-end locality; no modern identification asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0616:b001:l014: Ат бороюн сыдырдым: traversed the whole earth; see edition glossary1834:b001:l022 and https://el-sozduk.kg/атборой/
notes.manas-2010:p0616:b001:l020: Ботом literally my camel calf, rendered affectionate my child.
notes.manas-2010:p0616:b001:l024: Eighteen thousand worlds retained as sacred cosmological number.
notes.manas-2010:p0616:b001:l025: Колотуп билчү is provisionally rendered rule/subdue in the surrounding lordship context.
notes.manas-2010:p0616:b001:l026: Khizir is the named supernatural patron; дубана wandering holy man.
notes.manas-2010:p0616:b001:l028: Кырк чилтен are the forty invisible saints; both occurrences of forty retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0616:b001:l030: Parenthesized lines30–31 are spoken verse, not editorial prose.
notes.manas-2010:p0616:b001:l032: Баш териң literally skin of your head; your very head is the contextual physical reading.
notes.manas-2010:p0616:b001:l037: Riding/seeking clause kept on37; resulting appearance on38.
notes.manas-2010:p0617:b001:l008: Black seeing eye self-identification retained, despite apparent third-person reference to the speaker in7.
notes.manas-2010:p0617:b001:l011: Элимди literally my people, retained even for adversarial Manzhuu/Chinese communities.
notes.manas-2010:p0617:b001:l016: Кара нээт directly describes Jakyp as ill-intentioned; not softened into a neutral epithet.
notes.manas-2010:p0617:b001:l018: Black eye formula repeated, provisionally his (Jakyp’s) eye in this clause.
notes.manas-2010:p0617:b001:l023: Аш here is the memorial feast, not merely a meal.
notes.manas-2010:p0617:b001:l041: Чолпон Venus and Үркөр Pleiades; no modern astronomical alignment claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0617:b001:l042: Болжош is rendezvous/one who meets you; companion sought in the following list.
notes.manas-2010:p0618:b001:l003: Жазайыл is musket; death by its shot rather than impact of the weapon itself is intended.
notes.manas-2010:p0618:b001:l006: First-person object is supplied from the burial-companion context; the Kyrgyz conditional itself leaves subject implicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0618:b001:l019: Түмөн ten thousand; seven = seventy thousand, epic magnitude.
notes.manas-2010:p0618:b001:l027: Visible Кураныңды means your Quran by ordinary dictionary; translated literally. Martial context might suggest a defect for куралыңды (your weapon), but this is not silently substituted. https://el-sozduk.kg/куран/
notes.manas-2010:p0618:b001:l030: Who never draws back when charging: subject is Manas, continued through the first-person boast33.
notes.manas-2010:p0618:b001:l035: Күптү жазуу relieves pent-up grievance/desire. Here a taunting offer to satisfy the challenger’s craving for combat. 2015dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/күп/
notes.manas-2010:p0619:b001:l006: Кутпа north, following shared glossary and established primary lexical sense.
notes.manas-2010:p0619:b001:l007: Kyzylbash and Khiva are epic ethnogeographic names; lowercase source does not negate proper-name usage.
notes.manas-2010:p0619:b001:l010: Бараң retained as epic ethnonym Baran in the parallel list of hostile peoples; not the homonymous firearm.
notes.manas-2010:p0619:b001:l018: Кайгыланган доо literally sorrowful/troubling dispute; syntax remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0619:b001:l019: Айта-буйта urgency expression rendered before uttering a word.
notes.manas-2010:p0619:b001:l028: Мендe is mortal; the broken fall/escape syntax is translated conservatively.
notes.manas-2010:p0619:b001:l036: Burut is the opponents’ designation for Kyrgyz, retained as a historical exonym in quoted speech.
notes.manas-2010:p0619:b001:l039: Бажы levy/tribute, consistent with earlier conflict over tribute.
notes.manas-2010:p0619:b001:l041: Бейпай тарт- suffering/worry, directly confirmed by Yudakhin. https://el-sozduk.kg/бейпай/
notes.manas-2010:p0620:b001:l002: Токол hornless, metaphor of lacking kin/support; not second wife in this context.
notes.manas-2010:p0620:b001:l005: Сопол isolated/desolate in the loneliness context; tail/shortened image may remain beneath this epithet.
notes.manas-2010:p0620:b001:l007: Warrior bound around one’s waist is the repeated support metaphor.
notes.manas-2010:p0620:b001:l010: Санат memorable/exemplary deed provisionally; exact boasting idiom remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0620:b001:l018: Суюлуп literally thinned; drooping mustache under tears is a provisional physical interpretation.
notes.manas-2010:p0620:b001:l022: Baabedin named saint invoked before the sacrifice; no new full ritual text supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0620:b001:l032: The source explicitly says the mare is beheaded standing, without first throwing her down.
notes.manas-2010:p0620:b001:l036: Ала көөдөн rash/impulsive; анткор crafty/dissembling; both descriptors preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0621:b001:l004: Өңдөн аарды is provisionally loss of facial freshness; exact form аар remains lexically uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0621:b001:l006: Тиздедим read literally brought to the knees, in exhausting his steed.
notes.manas-2010:p0621:b001:l007: Printed угуп is positive heard, unlike negative көргүс; asymmetry retained rather than silently changing to укпаган.
notes.manas-2010:p0621:b001:l019: Born in Zhelpinish is retained despite623:l037 saying he was taken there after his father’s death; no harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0621:b001:l020: A mother appearing from the unseen retained without reconstructing a missing adoption story.
notes.manas-2010:p0621:b001:l023: Кымбат preciousness/favor; supplied favor remains contextual, not a specified object.
notes.manas-2010:p0621:b001:l024: Жойболот retained as Joybolot, an individual weapon designation associated with the red spear; exact apposition provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0621:b001:l025: Көөлөгөн rendered brandished in the weapon context; not ordinary soot-blackening.
notes.manas-2010:p0621:b001:l034: Талаалаган жыйганым provisionally gathering wilderness wanderers; object is implicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0622:b001:l001: Milk lake and fatty fish are paradise/abundance imagery, retained rather than a modern geographic identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0622:b001:l002: Май болуп literally becoming butter/fat; like butter remains provisional image.
notes.manas-2010:p0622:b001:l012: Жетим чөл lonely/orphan desert; not assigned a modern place identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0622:b001:l014: Куш кылды literally made a bird; miraculous speed/steed image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0622:b001:l019: Кулач is the outstretched-arm span, approximately a fathom, not an exact modern measure.
notes.manas-2010:p0622:b001:l020: Тобурчак noble battle horse; кериш conflict.
notes.manas-2010:p0622:b001:l025: Аб ийири жабылып honor covered/protected, rendered safeguarded.
notes.manas-2010:p0622:b001:l028: Кылым in this epic context is people/nation, not seven centuries.
notes.manas-2010:p0622:b001:l037: Кызыталак invective rendered damned, preserving coarse force without mechanically reproducing its etymology.
notes.manas-2010:p0623:b001:l005: Six geese preserved as printed; no inference of six human companions.
notes.manas-2010:p0623:b001:l011: Narrator’s attribution remains one verse row within Bakay’s speech.
notes.manas-2010:p0623:b001:l015: Даары bestow supernatural patronage/blessing, not medical treatment here.
notes.manas-2010:p0623:b001:l021: A city bearing Bay’s name is reported by the character, not externally located.
notes.manas-2010:p0623:b001:l026: Whip-height partition retained literally; no added execution or age-cutoff detail.
notes.manas-2010:p0623:b001:l028: Тумшуксуз = unfortunate, confirmed Yudakhin; not literal noseless. https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?lfrom=kg&lto=ru&word=тумшуксуз
notes.manas-2010:p0623:b001:l032: Буйла camel nose-peg/lead, metaphorically a leader or guide for Muslims.
notes.manas-2010:p0623:b001:l033: The fulfilled wish clause’s temporal relation is unclear; not rewritten as an unfulfilled dying wish.
notes.manas-2010:p0623:b001:l037: Taken to Zhelpinish after the father’s death; retained beside differing birth statement621:l019.
notes.manas-2010:p0624:b001:l006: Кир sorrow/trouble in the breast, matching the previous divine trouble line; not rendered merely dirt.
notes.manas-2010:p0624:b001:l016: The steed’s saddle sores are explicit; no generalized promise of easy travel substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0624:b001:l021: Телегейи тең expresses untroubled abundance/everything at hand.
notes.manas-2010:p0624:b001:l025: Interior breadth of Manas is moral generosity expressed through geography.
notes.manas-2010:p0624:b001:l027: БагалакII/абалак is the horn striker in the knucklebone circle game; unlike trouser-leg sense613:l031. https://el-sozduk.kg/багалак/
notes.manas-2010:p0624:b001:l031: Күрдөөңдү read through күрдөөн difficulty/torment; resolve difficulties, not unsupported restlessness. https://el-sozduk.kg/күрдөө/
notes.manas-2010:p0624:b001:l032: Күптү is pent-up grief/grievance; relieve sorrow follows 2015dictionary, https://el-sozduk.kg/күп/
notes.manas-2010:p0624:b001:l042: Yudakhin мураа has faithful companion in an exact Manas relationship formula; chosen over the edition glossary1841:l012 inheritance sense. https://el-sozduk.kg/мур/
notes.manas-2010:p0625:b001:l002: Кул literally servant/slave; servant retained in the paradoxical praise of Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0625:b001:l008: Кадыр түн Night of Power is a blessing metaphor; edition glossary1838:l017 sacred night.
notes.manas-2010:p0625:b001:l014: Күрдөөңдү difficulty/torment; understand your difficulties provisionally, with тапчу literally finding.
notes.manas-2010:p0625:b001:l018: Атын is his horse, retained rather than silently changing to your horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0625:b001:l022: Үч убак three times/occasions retained; exact armor-donning action uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0625:b001:l027: Printed бери read contextually as бөрү wolf from repeated625:l015; visible spelling not changed in raw.
notes.manas-2010:p0625:b001:l033: Hanging belly/great paunch are positive heroic physique here, retained without modernizing the body ideal.
notes.manas-2010:p0625:b001:l035: Теңиз sea/ocean retained as an epithet of Bakay; no second character named Tengiz introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p0626:b001:l006: Бадана mail, торгой көз lark-eye rings; double construction retained without specifying undocumented metallurgy.
notes.manas-2010:p0626:b001:l007: Subject of reciprocal/plural кийишет uncertain; he follows the recurring Manas description.
notes.manas-2010:p0626:b001:l014: Ridge/fortress with nests is a sheltering-kin metaphor, not a literal new fortress identified.
notes.manas-2010:p0626:b001:l019: Кыяматтык until Judgment Day, the lifelong sworn-companion formula.
notes.manas-2010:p0626:b001:l020: Abrupt now-going-to-Altay phrase retained; temporal syntax not harmonized with following birth report.
notes.manas-2010:p0626:b001:l025: Эң Чоң Жинди is the protective nickname, translated Greatest Madcap rather than counted as untranslated phrase.
notes.manas-2010:p0626:b001:l034: Кочкулар mighty/rams as warrior metaphor; subject connections through40 remain compressed.
notes.manas-2010:p0626:b001:l038: Ченчи reconnaissance agent/scout, not a modern official rank.
notes.manas-2010:p0626:b001:l040: Manas understood as destroyer of the envoys, though pronoun reference changes from Esenkan in the preceding lines.
notes.manas-2010:p0627:b001:l006: He here refers to the attacker Zholoy named8, not Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0627:b001:l007: Кечил monks in the invading forces; collective category retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0627:b001:l010: Praise resumes Manas after Zholoy’s retreat; source leaves subject implicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0627:b001:l023: Мураапы = мурапы, kin who provide support, Yudakhin sense2. Same-edition glossary1841:l011 also gives heir/support. https://el-sozduk.kg/мурапы/
notes.manas-2010:p0627:b001:l028: Will regard you as a prophet, not a claim that the Prophet will see Bakay.
notes.manas-2010:p0627:b001:l031: Will regard you as a saint, parallel28.
notes.manas-2010:p0627:b001:l032: Night of Power metaphor repeated explicitly, not omitted as redundant.
notes.manas-2010:p0627:b001:l038: Two reins and a lead rope symbolize taking command; literal equipment retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0627:b001:l042: Patterned chest and ten carpets are a separate formulaic image, retained despite abrupt transition.
notes.manas-2010:p0628:b001:l003: Inlaid/patterned chest and forty carpets repeat the image with changed numeral.
notes.manas-2010:p0628:b001:l007: Precious steep path literal; value of the protective ridge is the implied metaphor.
notes.manas-2010:p0628:b001:l012: Pregnancy craving for lion retained as printed, even where other episodes describe tiger meat.
notes.manas-2010:p0628:b001:l020: Ирик dialect large confirmed Karasaev; comparative койдон supports larger than sheep rather than a born wether. Чекир pale-eyed provisional. https://el-sozduk.kg/ирик/
notes.manas-2010:p0628:b001:l024: Eighty-one women die in this retrospective birth account; number retained without harmonizing with earlier version.
notes.manas-2010:p0628:b001:l027: Көк жал here literal blue/dark mane on the newborn’s back, the basis of the wolf-man epithet elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p0628:b001:l035: One undertaking becoming two is kept literal; implication of success/multiplication uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0628:b001:l042: Жалаяк broad/wide mouth provisional; жар кабак brow like a cliff.
notes.manas-2010:p0629:b001:l011: Бекер unbidden/without reason, not useless in this heart-drawn-to-him context.
notes.manas-2010:p0629:b001:l015: Доол interpreted as storm/wind blast, shelter provided by next line.
notes.manas-2010:p0629:b001:l016: Токой-чер forest thicket, reinforcing earlier disputed чер formula with clear positive context.
notes.manas-2010:p0629:b001:l017: Өнөк companion/partner, not an enemy’s habitual action.
notes.manas-2010:p0629:b001:l020: Барчын a mature eagle; exact age not supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0629:b001:l031: Friday’s Night of Power retained as narrated, without calendrical correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0629:b001:l041: Бозоң gray/open plain, provisional terrain sense; тоодак bustard.
notes.manas-2010:p0630:b001:l002: Horse and falcon praise address Manas metaphorically; not a change to talking about Bakay’s actual horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0630:b001:l012: Printed Алтай келди gives arrival at Altay; no silent emendation to from Altay.
notes.manas-2010:p0630:b001:l016: Казат holy campaign; religious martial force retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0630:b001:l021: Zhelpinish origin question is elliptical and rendered provisionally.
notes.manas-2010:p0630:b001:l029: Foreknowledge seven years before birth retained beside other chronology; no timeline reconciliation invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0630:b001:l038: Five corners of Mediyan and five circuits retained, unlike four-corner world formula.
notes.manas-2010:p0630:b001:l041: Мысыр Egypt, Багдат Baghdad; geographic extent is the character’s narrated claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0631:b001:l007: Ат бороюн = атборой whole earth; same-edition glossary1834:b001:l022 and primary2015dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/атборой/
notes.manas-2010:p0631:b001:l012: Kakanchyn is the epic Chinese realm, Great Beijing its named center; spelling retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0631:b001:l022: Көк жашык blue lean meat, literal emaciation image without correcting color.
notes.manas-2010:p0631:b001:l025: Enormous lice are explicit hardship hyperbole, not horses or birds substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0631:b001:l026: First-person hoof metaphor retained, as is the beak in28.
notes.manas-2010:p0631:b001:l028: Beak regaining wholeness figuratively renewed strength/fortune; not anatomical narrative.
notes.manas-2010:p0631:b001:l032: Табылгы meadowsweet/shrub, sheltering ravine image; exact botanical species not asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0631:b001:l035: Болот steel is a ready weapon metaphor for Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0631:b001:l038: Мураа faithful companion, Yudakhin exact epic relationship sense; see624:l042.
notes.manas-2010:p0631:b001:l042: The speech continues beyond631; batch end is not an episode ending.

transcription_check.scope: All twenty PDF page images visually inspected. Each page has42verse display rows,840total. No headings, prose or unresolved-source exclusions in this range. Raw unchanged; no manuscript collation.

alignment_check.method: All840ordered Kyrgyz/English pairs read after drafting; truncated output623–626 reread separately. Source order restored where modifiers moved; primary glossary/dictionary corrections applied and checked. Same-agent review only.
